data.reasoning: The package consists of standard AUR packaging files for a pre-compiled Java application. The PKGBUILD uses pinned sources with SHA256 checksums and performs standard file copying in the package() function. The auxiliary files (desktop entry, systemd service, and launcher script) are standard and contain no malicious payloads or unexpected network/file operations. The disagreement was solely due to an API error in one of the models.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' because it encountered HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to audit 'e-imzo.desktop' and 'e-imzo.service'. The deepseek model successfully audited these same files and correctly identified them as safe, standard configuration files.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review e-imzo.desktop and e-imzo.service due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient or format-related HTTP 400 errors from the LLM API to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts on simple files.
Ensure that partial audit failures on trivial config files can be resolved without permanently marking the entire package inconclusive if another model successfully clears them.
